description: Map a 0-to-100 score to a letter grade with a flat descending ladder of guards: a score outside [0, 100] raises ValueError (with the score echoed in the message), then 90+ is A, 80+ is B, 70+ is C, 60+ is D, and anything below 60 is F. Pure and deterministic. The golden arg_sets cover the value-returning domain, pinning every band-edge pair (90 vs 89, 80 vs 79, 70 vs 69, 60 vs 59) plus an interior point of each band and both in-range extremes (0 and 100), so the golden discriminates an implementation that shifts any threshold by one. The out-of-range inputs (-1 and 101, plus -100 and 200) live in the pytest suite as pytest.raises cases, since the recorder cannot capture exceptions.
constraints: deterministic, pure, no I/O, no randomness, no global state
